Day 17/ Bet you thought we forgot, but no, it’s reset day today.

Also good time to remind you to get Daybreak Blue access, it only takes 15 mins and you don’t want to have to do it in the middle of an incident.
Day 18/ Decisions API is GA, OpenResponses joined the Linux Foundation, we shipped some performance improvements and Uber is going all-in on codex & work. But yes… that’s a reset!
Landing tomorrow before 10am PST together with a small ship.
Day 19/ Small updates. Calls connect much faster for dots, changing reasoning in codex & work mid conversation does not invalidate cache anymore and a we've also updated the codex cli.

On codex cli updates. We've added reusable prompt presets, inline model and permission settings, and enterprise MCP sign-in. We've also fixed failures when resuming long sessions and added Windows corporate-proxy authentication.

Surprisingly the CLI has grown 2X in usage since devday.
The difference between having a tool and being a tool is subtle these days and it’s easy to accidentally build yourself into being a tool. Don’t be a tool.

One of the funny reasons for the difference in vibes between the influencers and the crowd today on 6.2 Sol/Astra is that we gave a few folks access a while ago and then made a lot of changes in the last 3-4 days and I'm pretty sure no re-testing was done within those days and the videos were produced last week.

Don't get me wrong, while the models are a hefty jump compared to their GPT predecessors, they are by no means perfect and there are a few things the teams are excited for the models to get better at in future iterations in terms of taste and niceness of use. Love all the feedback and we hear you!

Heads up, we’re starting to test dots with a small number of ChatGPT Plus users. Looking forward to the continued feedback as we expand and I’m recently seeing a lot more positives around how good the proactivity has been after many improvements. 

We’re also bringing dots to all ChatGPT Business Standard users. Rollout will start today.

We’re also working on a new mobile experience for ChatGPT! 

It’s easier to get to your favorite features and discover what you can do in ChatGPT. We’re starting with Pro users who have a dot or are eligible to create one. Your dot gets its own tab, and you can pin Codex, Projects, Images, and more to the tab bar. Some of you will see the new experience by default. 

You can turn it on or off anytime in Settings > New ChatGPT Design. 

Super excited to hear your feedback before we roll it out more widely!
Team is crazy enough to think they can succeed at improving the experience used by 1.2B users in place. Let's see if the strategy plays out.
